usage: kirocrew kas [-h] {install,status,remove,login,whoami,logout,route} ...

positional arguments:
  {install,status,remove,login,whoami,logout,route}
    install             Download this release's pinned KAS engine + Node
                        runtime
    status              Show the pinned engine, what is installed, and the
                        route
    remove              Delete installed engine versions
    login               Sign Kiro Crew's own vault in with a device code (no
                        browser needed here)
    whoami              Show which Kiro identity the vault is signed in as
    logout              Remove every Kiro identity from Kiro Crew's vault
    route               Print which program owns the Kiro sign-in here: kas-
                        bundle or kiro-cli

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
